Seven dialects. 一节讲 Prism 从一份 Lit 源码生成七个原生包、Hand-written wrappers: zero；改动日志一节的标题是 What changed in v4.2.0.，下面列了九条例如 A Closed Menu Put A Scrollbar On The Page；TOKENS 段直接把 --accent-primary #4d7ef7、--space-md 16px、--radius-lg 14px 写在页面上，说改这四个值整页跟着变。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
